profile.headline: AI Workflow Developer
profile.summary:
With over 20 years of technology consulting and software development, I discover and create solutions that help organizations solve complex issue and improve performance. I have a passion for simplifying complex processes and explaining them in clear and engaging ways. I have deployed software and created technology solutions for the Airline industry, logistics providers, technology consultants, publishing organizations, and the U.S. Federal Government.

Currently, I am a solutions consultant, contributing to AI prompt design, AI workflow automations, intuitive documentation, and generative AI applications.

positions.title: CEO
positions.description:
• Grew company from startup to multi-million annual revenue.
• Created a mobile airline portal generating over 5 million active subscribers in the first 12 months.
• Restructured federal data systems, resulting in 62% improved response performance and $2 million in cost savings.
• Developed eight travel apps and 30+ data management, logistics, and business portals.

My Accomplishments and Results:

o	Mobile AirAsia.com: first mobile airline technology in SE Asia, 25% sales increase in 2nd year.
o	Mobile GoIndigo.com: first mobile airline technology in India, more than 1 million customers in first year.
o	MasJisa.com: first online and mobile courier application in Malaysia, 100% sales growth in first year.
o	Recreation.gov: multi-agency federal recreation portal
o	Volunteer.gov: multi-agency federal and state volunteer recruitment portal
o	NPS Data Portal: executive dashboard and performance portal, mobile/tablet/desktop enabled

Restructured federal data systems and improved operational performance, with results that include:
o	14% increase in annual recruitment through volunteer.gov single-portal efficiencies
o	115% increase in total number of available federal and state volunteer opportunities 
o	300% increase in youth federal program volunteer participation
o	55% reduction in program staff hours with online data management and reporting tools 
o	62% improvement in response time for online applications
o	5 FTE reduction (full time employee) through strategic online accounting program software
o	$2 million taxpayer dollars saved annually resulting from portal operational consolidation
o	Cybersecurity enhancements and adoption of standard IT procedures

projects.title: AI Workflow Automation
projects.description: Created and testing a React/Node JS-based document content workflow AI Agent using ChatGPT API. This Agent allows users to ingest, summarize, categorize, and retrieve Word/PDF/Excel/Text documents from their document repositories. Data is presented in a visual dashboard with links to original sources. Meta data and keyword searches can be performed by voice (AI translation) and results downloaded to CVS format. Agent admin users can choose from a list of available ChatGPT models. The Agent also includes a lite web version in PHP designed for smaller organizations. Beta-release is planned for end of 3rd quarter 2025.

projects.title: mPrompt AI Prompt Management Tool
projects.description: I am developing a personalized prompt management app which allows users to create, edit, categorize, copy, share, and save detailed AI prompts in a secure web app. The app also has a JSON conversion feature which renders the prompt in JSON format. This will save time when trying to perfect AI prompts and combining the power of sequential multi-step prompts. The prompts created can be copied and used within any AI platform.
